name: Tekscend Photomask Corp.
summary: Tekscend Photomask Corp. manufactures and distributes semiconductor photomasks in Japan, China, Taiwan, South Korea, the United States, Europe, and internationally. It offers photomasks, including binary and phase shift masks, and EUV photomasks; 3D photomasks; and silicon stencil masks/molds for nanoimprint, including quartz and silicon molds. It also photomasks for various applications, such as MEMS, semiconductor packaging substrates, LED, tool accuracy control, high resolution printing, IC bump packaging, micro lens array, thermal head, and OEM qualification and research.
